top_n.description: How many ranked items the report shows; the rest become one '...and N more' line.

item_kind.description: A word for the reader: company, person, meeting, ...

rank_by.description: Ordering keys, applied in order; ties on every key are broken by item_label.

order.description: For field verdict: the verdict words, best first.

direction.description: For score (default desc) and item_label (default asc).

now.description: Current time, ISO 8601, for report.meta.generated_at. Optional: without it the skill uses the run start time from its instructions. Never guessed.

branches.description: Optional bound for_each result (v2): the object {branches, cut, cut_count} or its bare branches list, one entry {item, outputs, status ok|failed|skipped, error?} per branch in input order. When present it is the evidence; absent or null, the skill reads the judge steps' outputs (v1).

item.description: The item this branch ran on, e.g. a list-prepare accepted entry {index, item, item_key, query}. Names a failed branch; never copied into the output.

outputs.description: The branch step's output, or {<step id>: <output>} when the branch ran several steps. The one holding item_result is the judge.

cut.description: The items past the loop's limit, which got no branch.

cut_count.description: How many items were cut at the loop's limit; reported as not evaluated.
Items past the for_each loop's limit that got no branch (bind steps.<loop>.output.cut_count). Overrides a cut_count inside branches; 0, null or absent: none.
